background(255, 255, 255);

noStroke();

var getRGB = function(RGBValue){
    RGBValue -= 2147483647;
    var B = RGBValue                    % 256;
    var G = ((RGBValue - B)     >> 8)   % 256;
    var R = ((RGBValue - B - G) >> 16)  % 256;
    
    return [R,G,B];
};

// credit to http://stackoverflow.com/questions/596216/formula-to-determine-brightness-of-rgb-color Jive Dadson's answer for this code to determine the brightness of a color
// luminance constants
var rY = 0.212655;
var gY = 0.715158;
var bY = 0.072187;

// Inverse of sRGB "gamma" function. (approx 2.2)
var gam_sRGB = function(v) {
    if(v<=0.0031308) {
        v *= 12.92;
    } else {
        v = 1.055 * pow(v, 1.0/2.4) - 0.055;
    }
    return floor(v*255 + 0.5);
};

// sRGB "gamma" function (approx 2.2)
var inv_gam_sRGB = function(ic) {
    var c = ic/255.0;
    if (c <= 0.04045 ) {
        return c/12.92;
    } else {
        return pow((c+0.055)/1.055, 2.4);
    } 
};

// returns gamma-corrected brightness of an rgb value
var getBrightness = function(r, g, b) {
    return gam_sRGB(
            rY*inv_gam_sRGB(r) +
            gY*inv_gam_sRGB(g) +
            bY*inv_gam_sRGB(b)
    );
};

var s = pictureArray[0]; // amt of pixels in picture

textFont(createFont("Tahoma", 36), 36);

frameRate(0);
var d = 1000;
var draw = function() {
    var i = floor(random(1, pictureArray.length));
    {
        var RGB = getRGB(pictureArray[i]);
        
        //var l = getBrightness(RGB[0], RGB[1], RGB[2]);
        fill(RGB[0],RGB[1],RGB[2], 10 + 130 * 5 / d);
        
        var x = (i % s);
        var y = (i - i%s)/s;
        d = max(5, d - 1/1000 * d);
        ellipse(x*2.8,y*3,d,d);
    }
    fill(127 + 127 * cos(millis()/10),
        127 + 127 * sin(millis()/10), 
        127 - 127 * cos(millis()/10));
    
    text("Awwwww\nYiss\nHappy\nBirthday", 10, 50);
};
